scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b B Kumar

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c Yash Dayal b R Shepherd

batting.name: PD Salt
batting.dismissal: c DS Rathi b Akash Singh

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c A Badoni b Avesh Khan

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b W O'Rourke

balls.text: fullish, and wide of off. He has a big slash, and ends up with a single to long-off

taken at fine leg! Pooran was yet to hit a six, and he falls without having got one. A slower bouncer from Shepherd, who bowled it around middle and leg. Pooran looked to have a pull at it by riding the bounce, but couldn't clear the boundary. The ball is caught by Dayal... but hang on! Replays show the ball may have juuust slipped out of his hands. He looks to catch it with both hands, although there seemed to be a hint of the ball having touched the ground. It is referred upstairs by the on-field umpires, who rules it to be a clean catch
quite full, and angling across to come wide of off. Driven hard, and wide of long-off
swiped over fine leg! A low full toss again, and this comes on leg stump. Pant only squats, and has a free swing through the line for six. He doesn't move his feet at all there
bouncer from Shepherd on middle and leg. Pooran swivels to have a swat-pull to deep midwicket
the ball races away to the deep-third boundary. Pooran goes low, and opens the face of the bat at this dipping low full toss wide of off, and beats Salt to his right
now he looks to scoop again, then goes for the reverse scoop... but mises the ball altogether. It is quite full, and in the channel outside off from Dayal, who'll be happy to end over with a dot
shapes to scoop, but then hammers the pull over square leg!! Short in length, and wide-ish off, from back of the hand. Pant gets on top of the bounce, and sends the ball flying off his bat
the ball dribbles away to the deep-third boundary. Pant gets across the stumps early, and opens the face of the bat at this dipping low full toss which comes around seventh stump
on a fullish length, and around off. He drives hard to long-off, and doesn't run until a second or two
on the bounce to the man at deep cover moving to his right. Another very full ball wide-ish of off, as Pant lofts powerfully
the ball swings in, and comes on as a low full toss on middle. Swiped to deep midwicket
good ball. A wide yorker outside off, as Pant looks to slash but gets a bottom edge wide of the keeper

Pant reaches his hundred with a special shot!! He has a somersault after reaching the landmark. The ball is full and shaping away to arrive outside off, as he reaches out and lofts over extra cover after completely losing his balance. He tumbles while playing, and you know he's in great mood when he's doing that
another low full toss, as Bhuvi aims for the yorker. This comes on to middle, and Pooran has a hoick to hit it on the bounce to deep midwicket
the ball shapes away and arrives as a low full toss just outside off. Sliced to deep-backward point

top edge, and the ball flies over the keeper. He went having a half-hearted pull at this short ball pitching on middle but finishing outside off. But Pant ended up opening his stance up, and play at it awkwardly

good bowling. Angled across, and it lands as a yorker wide of off. He has a slash, but misses out. It's not called wide, though, and Pant reviews. Replays show the ball pitches just within the line, so it remains a dot ball
on the bounce to long-off! I completely forgot that Pant is on 90 - and he must have forgotten too - as he went lofting this full toss angling across, and arriving on off
another slower ball, but this full and wide of off. Pooran reaches out and drives to deep cover
a full toss on middle and off, and Pooran does well to open the face of the bat for two to deep-backward point
pulled forcefully to long-on. Short ball on off, and it's a slower ball too. But Pant reads the change of pace, and has a hard swing at it
another slower ball. This is angled across, and lands on the shorter side of a length around fifth stump. Pant has a slash, but the ball keeps low, and he misses
full, and angling across to pitch on off. Driven forward to long-on off the inside half of the bat
starts with a wide. Slower ball, and on a length outside leg. Pooran looks to swipe but misses

wonderfully sliced! The man at short third leapt full stretch, but the ball still went well over him. Bhuvi bowled another yorker, but this was slightly wide of off. Pant jammed his bat down, and opened the face of the bat to send that lofting for four more
another attempted yorker, as this one comes as a low full toss on middle and off. Squeezed towards midwicket off the bottom of the bat
angles this in, and bowls very full on the stumps. Clipped to deep midwicket

gone! Outside edge to Jitesh. Good comeback by Bhuvi. He bowled this with a scrambled seam, and quite full on sixth stump. Marsh went lofting again, but seemed to have gone too hard at it. The length, too, seemed too full to try and have a muscle at it. Eventually, Marsh ended up getting a little tickle behind to depart for 67
wide ball. Bhuvi goes for a near yorker, but really wide of off. Left alone by Marsh

launched wide of long-off! That was sent miles up in the air, and yet it landed deep in the stands. Bhuvi bowled this fuller, but again went wide of off. Marsh went through the line by leaning into the loft, and got another six
bam! Six over the bowler's head! Short of a length, and pace off, as Bhuvi goes a bit wide of off. Marsh gets on top of the bounce to pump it back
good comeback. This is a yorker, and around sixth stump. Pant has a slash, but is beaten

bang down the ground! This just clears the boundary. Again Pant slightly opens the face of the bat, and launches this fullish ball angling across and arriving wide enough outside off for Pant to have a free swing
lofted to deep cover, as he goes low and slashes at this very full wide outside off
nearly a yorker, and wide outside off. Marsh ends up driving it to the man at extra cover, who's right on the edge of the circle
misfield by Kohli at square leg, and that allows a single. Short ball on middle, and Pant pulls by riding the bounce

effortless! That hardly looked like going to the boundary, let alone going for six. Shepherd again bowls this wide-ish of off, but this is on a length. Pant opens the face of the bat, and slices it all the way for six
angles this across, and bowls this slower ball full and wide of off. Pant lets it go, and the umpire calls wide after a while
short in length, and much quicker on off. Pulled to deep midwicket
one-handed six! I think I said typical Pant one ball too early. He swings this across the line, as the ball dips on a length outside off, and bags six over wide long-on
a powerful slice to deep extra cover! Typical Pant, as he looks to attack by reaching out. His great hand-eye coordination does the rest, as this ball is fullish and slightly wide of off
this is tossed up, and dips as a very full ball on off. Marsh has a hoick, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep-backward square leg

wow, crashed over deep midwicket! Fifty for Marsh, too, as he continues his golden run. Short in length again from Suyash, who bowls this on the stumps. Marsh shifts his weight back, and clubs the ball with his pull shot
short in length, and slightly wide of off. Slapped on the bounce to extra cover
this is quick again at 113kph, and angling away to come as a full toss around sixth stump. Pant looks to have a swing, but misses
here comes the bouncer from Pandya! Short and wide of off, and left alone. Wide called

ohh, Tumbleman Pant! He shapes to have a swat at this short ball, which is wide of off, and then goes deep and across. Still misses his attempt, and ends up tumbling full circle. Jitesh even appeals half-heartedly for a stumping after whipping the bails off
low full toss, and flatter and quicker around seventh stump. Driven hard to deep cover
short in length, and angling across to arrive wide of off. Flashed to deep extra cover
Pandya dangles this ball full and wide of off, and Pant slashes to extra cover
quite full, and on the stumps. Biffed back to long-on
Shepherd follows the bouncer with a wide yorker outside off, which Marsh squeezes wide of extra cover's right

into the LSG dugout over long-on! That brings up 600 runs for him this season, as he gets a short ball rising nicely around sixth stump. He has the room to have a swat-pull, and clobbers the ball away
clipped off his toes. Shepherd goes wide of the crease, and ends up bowling this inswinger, which lands very full, and outside leg. Marsh just helps it wide of the keeper
Pant skips down the pitch, and also makes room, but Shepherd follows. He bowls a yorker outside leg, which Pant drives down to long-off
short in length again, but this finishes around sixth stump. It is chopped back to Shepherd by Pant

Agarwal from long-off and Seifert from long-o ran in each other's direction, but neither could catch this, even as Agarwal dived forward. Short ball wide of off, and Marsh went hammering at it, but got it off the top half of the bat
thumped back down the ground! Pant reads the slower ball, which is on a length, and just about on off. He waits for it to come, before flat-batting it to long-on's right
slower ball, and short in length. It pitches on middle, and the ball finishes outside leg. Swat-pulled to deep midwicket by Marsh
this swings in, and lands as a low full toss on off. Pant jams his down, and gets a single to long-on
on the fuller side again, but this is outside leg. Marsh looks to swipe through the line, but is hit on the side of his front leg
misfield at short fine leg, with Suyash placed there. It was a fullish ball floated on middle and leg, as Marsh got an inside edge in looking to push forward
wide outside leg. This is the inswinger from Dayal, who ends up bowling a yorker. Marsh looks to whip but misses
four flayed over short third! He throws his bat at this near yorker-length ball angling across and arriving wide of off, and gets the ball to fly off the top edge
Quick and fullish on fifth, Pant underedges a cut to short third's left
Pant brings up his second fifty of the season! LSG's hundred up too. Pulls it off the stumps through square leg, the fielder slid close to the boundary in vain
Salt misfields at deep-backward point, took a couple of steps to the right and tries to pick the ball up with both hands. Got up a touch too early. Was a length ball on fifth that was cut
Dances down and goes for the on-drive, bat-face turns inwards and the ball goes to long-on's left. Pant covered the length there but not the line
Fullish on leg, 91ks, punched to the bowler

Off the bottom of the bat but it sails over the sightscreen. The googly landed on fifth and spun away, was on the fuller side of length, Pant's forward stride was straight. So, he had to reach out with his hands to slap it, somehow got good enough connection
Pant takes the back leg to sixth stump while keeping the front foot in place to cut the length ball to deep-backward point. 125ks
Shepherd goes for another one, lands the 137ks ball just in front of the crease around seventh, driven to deep cover
Very low full toss on fourth goes under the bat as Marsh tries to drive through cover.
Change of plan. Wide yorker, but it's well past the tramline. Marsh stands still and lets it go
Slightly back of length and that's enough for Marsh to pull. 118ks legcutter but it bounces even and doesn't deviate, whacked from waist-height over square leg
Slow again, from wide of the crease, on a length through fourth, Caressed to deep point
Slower one goes past the cut. Not much bounce on that three-quarter length ball on fourth
Very full on fourth, 99ks. Pant might feel he missed out there. Didn't get much of a forward stride though. Drove hard, off the inside-half to long-on
Marsh winds up for a cross-bat shot but changes his mind late as the length ball was coming in towards middle. Punches it to long-off
Googly on fourth. Length ball, cut to deep-backward point
Not that short, Marsh looks to pull. The skiddy ball hits over the knee roll and pops over the keeper
Flatter googly. Lands around fourth and goes straight on, punched through cover
Goes for the slog sweep. Gets it along the ground to deep midwicket. Suyash gave it air, bowled fullish on leg

Livingstone runs right from deep square leg, tumbles, but the ball's rolling behind gently, he turns and dives back but has hands on the cushion while pulling the ball in. Was a shin-high full toss around middle that was flicked
First short ball of the over is punished. Landed very short but finished around rib-height. Pulled over deep midwicket, to the left of the car.
Another pace-on yorker. 136ks. Leg-stump line. Flicked to long-on, Marsh pushed his front leg out the way very rate
Yorker on leg, jams a flick through midwicket
Full around fifth, punched to the right of cover. Krunal dives to stop it
Fuller side of length on fifth, driven to deep cover. 127ks
Wide and full, released from slightly wide of the crease, smeared to long-off
Top edged cut over the keeper. Marsh cleared the front leg early, got a wider one that was away from his arc. It was short, so he threw his hands at it, got a thick enough edge to fly
Full-toss. No-ball called. This was dipping, but RCB don't review. At the stumps, Marsh was mostly upright, got the horizontal bat well fully in front and crouched late, pulls to short fine
Full again, touch too straight though. Flicked through square leg
Another yorker attempted, wonder when he'll change his length. Low fully on off, driven to mid-off. 134ks
Early release again. Low full toss on middle, no swing, Pant steps leg side late and punches to mid-off. 115ks
Yorker on fourth, 115ks, jammed to mid-on. Bowled from way behind the crease, next to the stumps, Pant's backlift was high but the downswing had little power
Fullish on middle and leg, defended off the inner-half of the full faced bat to midwicket
Length on fifth, dabbed to backward point. This one might've shaped away a touch
Another slower one, close to a back of length but bounces about three-fourth of the way up the stumps. Punched from outside off through cover
Likely the slower one, yes. 118ks. Fullish on the pads, flicked softly towards midwicket
Pant tumbles after missing a premeditated scoop. Was a hard-length ball on leg stump, luckily it bounced over the stumps
Three-quarter length on off, Marsh opens the face and defends towards cover for a quick single

Excellent shot. Stands upright and waits for the back-of-lengther to arrive next to him, flat-bats it into the ground. Too straight for mid-on. Slightly scrambled seam too, shows that the bounce was true
Pitched up on fourth, 131ks, punched to mid-off
Calculated top edge. No deep third, so Pant jumped and cut the shortish ball despite not having much room. Edge was around the sticker and that took it fine
Easier two this time. Deep third has to run to the right to stop it. Was a length ball on fifth that was cut
Pant slog sweeps a pace-on ball over square leg. Close to his best. Got on one knee and launched it from middle stump
Tight second, Marsh stopped for a moment after completing the first, managed to just about make it as the throw went over the stumps. Was a length ball on leg that was flicked
French cut to deep fine leg. Nutmegged him actually. Pitched up on fifth, Pant lunged and tried to punch it through extra
Wide and full, let go. No swing.

Swing's back and it's so very late. A low-release, slingy low full toss was coming in towards middle for most of its path before deviating towards off. Breetzke gave himself room and tried to caress it through cover. Then tried to adjust into a square drive, got no contact.

Pace-on bouncer pops off the helmet and somehow flies over short third. Breetzke crouched a touch and went for the pull, he was hit high, around the temple as the head turned a bit. It's why it deflected away. Looks in good spirits as the physio goes through the concussion check
Cutter doesn't rise. Dug deep into the pitch, Breetzke's pull is beaten by lack of pace and bounce. He crouches and wears one on the ribs
Dances down and slaps it to cover. No swing on that length ball at fourth, Breetzke's making room and getting the cross-bat out. The bounce was even there

Quick single to cover. Jitesh appeals for a run out, not sent upstairs. Was a length ball on off that was punched, flat throw over the stumps, Jitesh parried it onto the stumps. He wanted to catch it but it hit low on the palm. Batter's in
Stays leg side of the length ball on fourth and pushes it to point
Makes room late and caresses the length ball on off through point. Timed nicely again
Picked up over mid-on. It was flighted down leg at 81ks, Breetzke waited a while before taking the front leg out of the way and driving effortlessly
Length on middle and leg, 95ks and flat, defended to cover. No spin
Full on leg, 87ks, flicked sofrly to mid-on's left for a quick single
Overpitched this time and it's on the pads, flicked through midwicket with ease
Dipping yorker with late outswing, nearly kisses off stump. Breetzke's opened up too, tried to defend it down the ground and was beaten on the outside edge

Likely an inside edge, big appeal from Thushara who's able to convince Jitesh for a review. Clear deflection off the edge onto pad, no need for Ultra-Edge. The low full toss came in towards the base of middle and leg, Marsh tried to punch it with a straightish bat
A bit of swing again, finds a leading edge. The low full toss was dipping on off, Marsh is squared up a touch as he tries to push it through mid-on. Soft hands take it along the ground through third
Quick single to mid-on, a defensive prod with a straight bat to a 140ks fullish ball swinging into middle
Swings away but the starting line's leg stump. Length ball's flicked along the ground to deep square leg

swept away over square leg! RCB make it to Qualifier 1! A friendly full delivery on the stumps, and Jitesh gave it his all in dumping the ball beyond the boundary. Jitesh reminds the world of his potential, when we all wondered where the chase would end up after Kohli's dismissal. A captain's knock of 85* off just 33 balls, an innings which has even put Pant's 118* into oblivion
angled across with a roundarm, and full and wide of off. Left alone, and not called wide
a yorker on leg, and he shifts his weight back to clip this towards midwicket. Two more in no time
flat and quick, and on a length on middle. Pulled to long-on
two in a row!! This one flies high into the sky, before landing over the midwicket boundary. He's deep in the crease again, and flings this ball out for back-to-back sixes
swatted back down the ground!! That went bang 90 degrees back. Short delivery on off or thereabouts, and absolutely clobbered for six
flung away over extra cover! He's taking RCB home. Jitesh sits deep in the crease, and lofts this length ball outside off to powerfully dispatch that for another boundary
another bouncer, but this time Jitesh is beaten. O'Rourke bangs this on off, and gets it finish on leg, as Jitesh looked to hook but missed
ramped over short third! Jitesh makes room, and rides the bounce of this bouncer, which shapes in from outside off to finish around leg. He's leaping in the crease while playing that, and gets four
slashed on the bounce to the man at deep cover point, as O'Rourke bowls on the shorter side of a length, and around sixth stump
full ball dipping on the stumps, and nudged behind square
on a length on keg, and punched to mid-off to keep ticking

backs away, and Rathi fires this on a fullish length by going wide of off. Jitesh reaches out to have a slash but misses. It isn't called wide, and Jitesh reviews. So we have another break in play, and Pant and Rathi have a chat. Jitesh ended up reaching out for this wide ball outside off, and the third umpire says "some part of the ball is inside the revised guide line". So it's not a wide
full on the stumps, and driven to long-off. There's no hurry now, with that early six
full and flat, and wide of off. Driven to extra cover for a quick single
kabooooom! Fifty for Jitesh! The ball lands a dozen rows beyond the midwicket boundary. Length ball dipping around middle, and Jitesh has a liberal heave at it across the line

gone! Taken at point! Jitesh is down on his knees. It was a good low catch by Badoni there, who did well to grab it just off the ground. Jitesh went reverse sweeping at this fullish ball dipping on the stumps, but didn't get it either wide or above the fielder. But he has been asked to wait - at first I thought for the catch, but wait, it's a no-ball!!! In fact, it's a back-foot no-ball. His back foot is touching the line
on the fuller side, and outside off. Jitesh tries too hard to have a heave, but ends up dragging it to long-on
short ball around sixth stump, and the ball finishes closer to off. Jitesh looks to upper cut, but is beaten by the bounce and the pace
goes inside out over extra cover! Another slower ball, and Jitesh isn't fooled again. He makes room, and lofts this fullish ball around off for another boundary
slower ball, and pumped back! It was full on middle and off, and Jitesh let the ball come on to him before launching it down the ground for four more. Long-off beaten to his right comfortably

wow, Jitesh shapes to scoop - and gets across the stumps - and Avesh responds by banging in a bouncer. It is called wide as the ball balloons over middle. But Pant reviews last moment. He uses the time to have a word with Avesh. Jitesh ducked a little as the ball zoomed over, and replays show the ball travels well above even if he wasn't ducking. So it remains a wide, and LSG lose a review
pretty full again, and this arrives on middle and off. Agarwal drills this to long-off
very full, and swinging into off. Driven back aerially, and the ball runs away to long-off even as Avesh got his right hand to it

another miss in the field, and four more! LSG's fielding hurting them big time. Short in length, and outside off, as Agarwal shifted his weight back, and slashed at this through cover point. The fielder threw himself to his left, but in vain

goes for the reverse sweep, but is seemingly hit on his right pad. Shahbaz appeals for lbw, but it's not given. The ball dribbles away behind point. Replays show there was glove involved, so no pad there
swept away to deep square leg!! Jitesh is taking it away here. He takes a good stride out at this dipping ball on length on middle and off, and swings at this to go aerially
powerful hit over extra cover! He makes room, and skips down the pitch to thump this length ball outside off. Flat-batted, and for six!
great effort by Bishnoi! He was at deep-backward square, and ran and slid to his right to prevent two runs. Jitesh swept this fullish ball around middle
fumble from O'Rourke!! What was a certain single is now a four. He was at deep cover, and moved to his left, but let the ball slip. Length ball just outside off, as Jitesh cut away
a fumble at long-off now, as Agarwal lofts this length ball down. Two more, and RCB remain afloat in the big chase

run-out chance missed!! Agarwal called for a single, but Jitesh had his eyes on the ball. Length ball just outsdie off, and slashed on the bounce to short third, where Rathi fumbled. Agarwal went for the run, while Jitesh kept watching the ball. Amid the throw to O'Rourke, the batters did get the run

this time the reverse scoop works for Jitesh. He sits deep in the crease, opens his stance up, and switches over last moment, as the ball is a high-ish full toss on off. Four between keeper and short third
deposited over long-off! Another slower ball from O'Rourke, but this is fullish, and on off. Jitesh backed away, and went through the line to dispatch that

a mistimed loft over short third! Badoni does well to turn around from backward point, and give it a chase. He pulls the ball back last moment, and keeps it to three, as Agarwal opened the face of the bat to have a slice at this slower ball, which is full and outside off
full and wide of off, and driven slightly aerially to long-off. I almost thought O'Rourke got his hat-trick there
on a fullish length on middle and off, and driven to extra cover for a hurried single. Direct hit at the non-striker's end would have been close
on a length on leg, and moving away to end on middle, as he bowled at only 116kph. Whipped to deep midwicket
he goes for the reverse scoop, but ends up getting it off the inside edge to short fine leg. He shaped to play that early, as the ball dipped to come on as a full toss wide-ish of off
a low full toss just outside off, as the ball angles across. He drives but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket. Quick running gives them two
pulled to deep midwicket, as he plays this off the back foot off this short ball arriving on off
he bowls from wide of the crease, and on a length on the stumps. Jitesh was backing away, and ended up chipping towards mid-off, with the ball hitting the higher side of the bat

misfield by Samad at backward point, and Agarwal gets two more. It was a good-length ball in the channel outside off, as Agarwal cut at it late. Both batters watched the ball went, and capitalised quickly on the fumble
on a length on off, and it straightens after pitching. Agarwal goes back to nudge this towards midwicket, and they bag in no time
a low full toss on off, and driven hard to long-on

whipped to deep midwicket! The fielder there, placed wider than usual, ran and dived to his left, but the ball still managed to get into contact with his body, which was touching the boundary. It was a full ball swinging into middle, as Jitesh played with the movement

sliced to long-off! RCB had already slowed down, and this wicket will hurt them further. Avesh swung this ball in, and pitched it on a fullish length around off. Kohli went lofting through the line, and played with the full face of the bat and with a high left elbow. But none of that got him the distance he would have liked. Good low catch by Badoni, and LSG land a big blow
quite full, and swinging into off. Driven hard along the ground, and wide of long-off. The batters pushed for two, but there was hardly any time
fuller, and quick again. This skids through on middle and off, and is clipped behind square
on a length, and quicker on middle and off. Punched to long-on
shortish in length around off, and turning in. Pulled to deep midwicket
cut away from very close to the stumps! On a fullish length, and this is just outside off, as he plays very late to beat point to his left
ohh! This stays low off a fullish length just outside off, as it straightens after pitching. Agarwal looked to pull but missed
gets this to dip on a full length, and just outside off. Chopped to point
Punched to cover off the front foot, slight fumble. Agarwal says no to the second
Cut between short third and backward point. Line's the issue again. Back outside off, on a length through fifth. Agarwal waits for the slower one and hits late. Kohli's pumped
Akash overcompensates with the line. Went bouncer but it came just under the armpits at 120ks, Agarwal swivels and pulls it fine. Too fine for deep fine leg
Cut in front of point. Too square for sweeper cover. Was a fifth-stump ball just over stump height, Agarwal crouched and played it with the ball almost past him
Wide on a length, steered to sweeper cover
Caressed with the horizontal bat through extra to bring up fifty. Kohli looks around intently while raising the bat. Wasn't that short but slightly wide, left-armer's angle helped
Very flat on a fullish length. Punched from off stump to long-off
Driven over the bowler effortlessly. Through the line. Fullish ball was on middle and Kohli was beside it. Slid the back leg out of the way and continued to middle the ball
Well stopped at cover, Badoni dives to the right to deny the single. Was a length ball on leg that Kohli punched after making room
Fullish outside off, 101ks, driven hard but finds cover
Agarwal doesn't account for the turn and gets a bottom edge trying to nudge it to cover. Was a length ball going through fifth
96ks length ball at the stumps, punched to long-on

Lbw given, looked out. No review. Back to back for O'Rourke! LIvingstone went across to off stump and tried to flick the 135ks full ball from the crease. It went past the edge and hit him flush on the front foot. Pitching off, impact middle, hitting leg

Slower one and Patidar slashes straight to backward point. 118ks cutter on a length was wide, Patidar walked into the shot. Wanted to go over cover, got a thickish edge that went flat around chest-height
Attempted yorker turns into a knee-roll high full toss down leg. Goes past the flick, Pant does well to half-stop it with a dive to the left
Mid-off in, so Kohli thrashes it over extra. Holds his shape too. O'Rourke goes too full, fourth stump, Kohli doesn't need to move his feet.
Full on fifth, guided to the left of backward point.
An almost no-look flick. Waited for the seam-up length ball to arrive to the top of his pad and lifted it pretty much with a vertical bat swing. Over fine leg
Good reactions from both batter and bowler. Kohli charged down early, so O'Rourke went slow and wide on a lenth. Kohli reached out and flapped it to long-on
Full on fourth, worked to long-on
Looked like he gave it air, but it's 100ks. Swept on the bounce to long-on
Edged, no slip. Four. Rathi beats Patidar for pace as he looks to cut. Carrom ball was over 100ks
97ks full ball on leg, flicked to deep square off the inside-half
Cut to the left of deep cover. Fourth-stump googly at 95ks spun in a touch and skidded. Good ball but Kohli was smooth
Misfield again, cover was walking back and got bad bounced. Bishnoi there. Was a length ball on fourth that was punched
Slight misfield to the left by backward point and it races away. Was a shortish ball around shoulder height, Kohli got the bat facing down on the late cut
Slower and fullish on the pads, flicked to deep square leg

No getting away this time, Salt is caught at cover. Akash whacks it into the pitch, 147ks although it didn't look that fast, angling away outside off. Salt didn't move across, tried to slap it over extra. It rose just above the shoulder, he jumped but still couldn't reach it.

Salt gets away with it. Almost got out to a high-ish full toss. Pace on, around thigh-high and angling away through fourth. Salt didn't make room and tried to carve it over extra, bottom hand came off. On the bounce to cover who ran in
Flicked off the pads to deep midwicket. 108ks on a fullish length at the pads
Scoots low off a length. It angled away through fifth. Kohli semi-collapsed after trying to drive it on the up through cover
140ks yorker following Salt as he makes room, whips it while sliding the back foot away. Finds square leg
Flat-batted again despite the lack of room. Back of length on middle and leg, Salt's able to make room just before playing the shot
Wide and shortish, goes past the flashy cut. Salt cleared his front leg and was beyond his reach. Not given wide, Salt surprised
Yorker on middle, perfect execution from wide of the crease. Jammed to mid-off
Wide on a back of length, cut to deep-backward point
Wow, that's pulled between mid-on and midwicket. Got it off shoulder height, it came slightly slowly off the pitch. Hit from in front of the body, wrists rolled again to reduce the risk.
Goes yorker. Fires a low fully down leg, it goes past the attempted flick

Another cut, finds the gap despite the off-side field being loaded. Went well to the left of Rathi at cover. Ball was on a length, came very flat and didn't offer much room. Was on leg replay shows. Salt just moved late. RCB's fifty up in four overs
Fullish on leg, punched against the angle to long-off
Quick single to mid-off. Salt made room and got followed by a length ball that he slapped again
Slapped hard, finds mid-off. Length ball on off at 92ks sat up a touch
Overpitched, thumped straight of mid-on. No spin, angling into leg. Salt cleared his front leg just a touch, wound up and followed through bigtime
Full on leg, punched to long-off
Goot shot... and fielding. Cut a flat legbreak on middle from a length, found Shahbaz at point
Bishnoi fumbles at deep midwicket, allows the second. 98ks length ball was on fourth, Salt was hurried a touch on the pull but got it along the ground
Rathi misses his line and gets pulled. Deep midwicket was out, this went over backward square leg. Was a very short ball that sat up and finished down leg, just over pad height
More defensive bowling. Flat on a length at off, Salt stands leg side and cuts to cover
Length on leg, whipped to deep square leg
101ks length ball on leg, whipped to long-on
Even better pull, this is from shoulder-height. Into the ground again, through forward square. The pace-on bouncer at fifth was quick off the pitch
Kohli dances down early, so O'Rourke went wide on a fullish length. Might've swung away a touch, let go
Pulled to the right of midwicket. From fifth stump, off a back of length. Rolled the wrists , bat turned in the hand but the placement was good
Edge... flies over short third. Kohli slashed hard at a rising length ball on fifth, wanted to go over cover
Too full, too straight, beats the flick and goes fine off the pad. Given runs but it looked like it was pad, Pooran got gloves on it but couldn't hold on
Full on leg, 131ks, whipped to deep midwicket on the bounce
Not there, seam up on fifth on a three-quarter length. Salt takes the smallest of forward strides and slaps it through cover
Bishnoi at midwicket jumps but Kohli's flick clears him easily. Full again, on off, Kohli's balance is spot-on
Full again, on off, driven off the inside-half to mid-on
Pitched up on off, 130ks, no swing, punched to mid-on. Akash stepped into the danger zone in his follow-through, ump has a word
Fuller side of length on middle, a bit of swing in, defended to the bowler's left
On the pads, clipped to short fine. Breetzke, at mid-off, can't collect Avesh's throw properly leading to an overthrow
Pumped over the bowler. Swinging and very full on middle, Salt didn't need to extend his arms to lift the drive
